methodology.fixture: Five or 150 unrelated artifacts, plus audit, plan, two history blocks and one published report; every call uses fresh Controller/Checkpoints/Store. No cross-tick cache.
methodology.sequence: Cold load; production record_session_turn and Controller.complete; deterministic report application; checkpoint; publication; receipt checkpoint; dashboard write/readback. Charged operation/session inputs are identical in both checkouts.
methodology.scope: Storage requests only; excludes admission, model dispatch, CI, native PR reviews and unrelated controller requests. Completion metadata/readbacks included.
methodology.traffic: Actual fake transport request counts; CommonMark/JSON response bytes are modeled, not live GitHub measurements.
methodology.recovery: Actual Controller.recover for a complete upload, partial upload, inline result and reused core, each after a lost completion checkpoint. Includes cold load, one full collection scan, direct verification and any checkpoint. Replacement-call cost is conditional; no model is dispatched by the instrument.
methodology.setup: Each workload includes separate synthetic fixture-setup counters, including unrelated artifact seeding. Bootstrap and queued-legacy publication have separate exception rows; neither is included in uninterrupted-call totals.
